name: Password input
summary: A text field for a password with a Show / Hide button so people can check what they typed.

anatomy.purpose: Button to show or hide, labeled in text.

whenToUse: Any place a password is entered.
whenNotToUse: Codes: use a one-time code input.

keyboard: Tab moves from field to toggle.
accessibility.focus: Focus ring on field and toggle.
notes: The toggle has a visible text label or an aria-label and aria-pressed.
